meta.title: My Favorite Men's Leather Jacket? The Taylor Stitch Moto Jacket Review
meta.description:
Subscribe or I'll freaking scream. Also follow me on Instagram: @8thWeekday. 

A leather jacket is a staple not in men's fashion but in fashion in general. It's one of the most famous materials in the world and for good reason! Now there are crazy leather jackets from designers like Gucci, Saint Laurent, and all those other big players BUT there are also crazy leather jackets from brands like Himel Brothers, The Real Mccoys and Schott! Two very different brand identities but they both make quality products (depending on your taste). Here though we have a jacket from Taylor Stitch that is made by Golden Bear. A trusted name in the leather jacket game for quite a while now! While they don't have the same prestige as many of the brands listed above they are still a great company! 

Does anyone know the song Leather Jacket by Joyce Manor? Love that darn song. Anyways the Taylor Stitch Moto Jacket in whiskey steerhide! A great leather jacket. Can you tell I'm trying to use the keyword "leather jacket" so YouTube shows off my video? Leather. Jacket. Yeah so it's a nice jacket of leather by Taylor Stitch.
